They speak energetically to the camera with high facial arousal. Behind them, a circular white sign hangs featuring a cow graphic and Chinese characters. (2) The scene moves to a restaurant entrance where the hosts interview a man in a black t-shirt, glasses, and a black mask. The environment features light-colored wooden paneling and a menu board. The hosts gesture frequently as they engage in conversation with the man. (3) The group is seated at a white table indoors. Behind them is a wooden shelf decorated with colorful Lego flowers, Super Mario figurines, and paper bags. The lighting is bright and artificial. The hosts react with exaggerated laughter and surprised facial expressions to the interviewee's words. (4) A close-up shows a hand placing a circular yellow sticker onto a wooden menu list outside. The video concludes with a group shot of the two hosts, the male owner, and a female staff member standing together in front of the restaurant's wooden exterior, posing for the camera.
